title: Master the CSS Box Model Fast

scenes.line1: Ever wonder why your layout breaks?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why your layout breaks? What is the box model in CSS?

scenes.label: Layers
scenes.sub: Content, padding, border, and margin shape every element.
scenes.say: Every element has four layers: content, padding, border, and margin.
Here’s a div with width, padding, border, and margin set. The width is just the content. Padding and border add to the box’s size, while margin is outside the box.

scenes.question: Is margin part of the element's width?
scenes.wrong: Yes, margin adds to the width.
scenes.right: No, margin is outside the box and not counted in the element's width.
scenes.say: Is margin part of the element’s width? It’s a common trap: margin is outside the box and not counted in the element’s width.
